basic_info.description: Sparkling fresh single family home in Mission Terrace. One of the oldest residences on the block, this updated home exudes charm and character. With recently remodeled kitchen and baths, refinished wood floors, and new paint inside and out, it is move-in ready. Main floor has kitchen, living room, partial bath and dining room ready for holiday entertaining. 3 bedrooms on upper level and beautifully updated bath. Bonus room and bath down - workout room? workshop? ... lots of possibilities!Extra large lot gives plenty of space for gardening, bbq'ing or just enjoying the great outdoors. The neighborhood is a pleasant reminder of the San Francisco of days gone by and is super convenient - walkable to all things retail on Mission Street, and is a commuter dream with plentiful public transportation options.
